slides.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro lands in Miami after fleeing Brazil
slides.body: The Miami Herald reported Bolsonaro fled Brazil and landed in Miami after his election loss.

photo.prompt: Crowded international arrivals area at Miami International Airport with cameras pointed at the doors, tense nighttime news scene

slides.headline: He lost Brazil’s presidential election before the trip
slides.body: Al Jazeera says Bolsonaro landed in Miami after losing Brazil’s presidential election.

photo.query: Brazil election polling station ballot box Wikimedia Commons

slides.headline: His family arrived with him in Miami
slides.body: The Times of Israel says Bolsonaro arrived in Miami with his family after Trump offered an exit from Brazil.

slides.headline: Reports placed part of the trip through Argentina
slides.body: EL PAÍS English reported Bolsonaro fled Brazil via Argentina.

slides.headline: After landing in the U.S., he declared himself Brazil’s rightful leader
slides.body: Reuters reported that Bolsonaro declared himself Brazil’s rightful leader after landing in the U.S. The Washington Post said he called himself Brazil’s true leader.
